description: Open the simple model rocket design file at /home/ga/Documents/rockets/simple_model_rocket.ork in OpenRocket. Add a new set of trapezoidal fins to the rocket's body tube. The fins should have 4 fins, a root chord of 80mm, a tip chord of 40mm, a height (span) of 60mm, and a sweep length of 20mm. After adding the fins, save the modified rocket design as /home/ga/Documents/rockets/modified_rocket_with_fins.ork using File > Save As.
